definitions.explanation: Fresh herbs, spices, or vegetables added to dishes as flavor enhancers or garnishes, often with aromatic or medicinal properties.

examples.japanese: ⟦そば→蕎麦：14329_soba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{薬味|やくみ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦ねぎ→葱：05189_negi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{添|そ}える→添える：13315_soeru⟧。
examples.english: Green onion is added to soba as a condiment.

examples.japanese: {薬味|やくみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦たっぷり→たっぷり：03404_tappuri⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I like to eat with lots of condiments.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冷奴|ひややっこ}→冷奴：27679_hiyayakko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{薬味|やくみ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{生姜|しょうが}→生姜：05191_shouga⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{定番|ていばん}→定番：12265_teiban⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Ginger is the standard condiment for cold tofu.

notes:
The term {薬味|やくみ} literally means 'medicinal flavor' - these ingredients were traditionally valued for both taste and health benefits.

Common {薬味|やくみ}:
- ⟦ねぎ→葱：05189_negi⟧/⟦{青|あお}ねぎ→青ねぎ：noentry⟧ (green onion)
- ⟦{生姜|しょうが}→生姜：05191_shouga⟧ (ginger)
- ⟦わさび→山葵：05121_wasabi⟧ (wasabi)
- ⟦{大葉|おおば}→大葉：17713_ooba⟧/⟦{紫蘇|しそ}→シソ：10955_shiso⟧ (shiso leaf)
- ⟦みょうが→みょうが：20822_myouga⟧ (myoga ginger)
- ⟦{大根|だいこん}おろし→大根おろし：26890_daikonoroshi⟧ (grated daikon)
- ⟦{七味|しちみ}→七味：20131_shichimi⟧⟦{唐辛子|とうがらし}→唐辛子：11871_tougarashi⟧ (seven-spice)
- ⟦ごま→胡麻：10337_goma⟧ (sesame)
- ⟦{海苔|のり}→海苔：10391_nori⟧ (nori)
- ⟦かいわれ{大根|だいこん}→かいわれ大根：noentry⟧ (daikon sprouts)

Different from ⟦{香辛料|こうしんりょう}→香辛料：04943_koushinryou⟧ (spices): {薬味|やくみ} are typically fresh, added at serving, while ⟦{香辛料|こうしんりょう}→香辛料：04943_koushinryou⟧ are dried spices used during cooking.
